compose.formula: for each product in order: out = round((below * shadow / 255) * (1 - a) + rgb * a), a = alpha / 255, straight alpha; the cushions: one set at a time, its shadow and its layer together

compose.variants: a variant replaces its slot's default layer and shadow at the same z; nothing else changes
